Nina: Quick thread: small follow-up on route_profile_v2 naming and location. prefer table analytics.route_profile_v2_compact to signal this is a denorm compact table.
Omar: fine by me. keep schema_version and tenant_id PK. also add route_id index for fast lookups.
Priya: make sure partitioning by tenant hash so heavy tenants don't blow single partitions. propose 32 partitions by tenant_mod.
Ethan: add column last_seen_ts for TTL-based compaction. we can drop rows older than 90 days for inactive routes.
